import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_62/test_0.csv"
    # Target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_62/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source data
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

    # Inspect columns:
    # ['Text Date', 'Value Date', 'Zip Code', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']
    # Target schema: ['Month': string, 'Water Use': float, 'Power Use': integer]

    # Transformation plan:
    # - The target 'Month' corresponds to 'Text Date' in source.
    # - Aggregate by 'Text Date' (Month) summing Water Use and Power Use.
    # - Water Use: float, Power Use: integer (round Power Use after sum)
    # - Some Water Use or Power Use may be null, sum will ignore nulls by default.
    # - Resulting dataframe columns: ['Month', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']

    # Group by 'Text Date' and aggregate
    grouped = df0.groupby('Text Date', dropna=True).agg({
        'Water Use': 'sum',
        'Power Use': 'sum'
    }).reset_index()

    # Rename 'Text Date' to 'Month'
    grouped.rename(columns={'Text Date': 'Month'}, inplace=True)

    # Ensure data types
    grouped['Water Use'] = grouped['Water Use'].astype(float)
    grouped['Power Use'] = grouped['Power Use'].round().astype(int)

    # Save to CSV
    grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
